heard: A serene cosmic hat is actually two galaxies stuffed inside one. Discovered in 1781, the Sombrero Galaxy lies 28 to 31 million light years away. It looks like a single, peaceful ring of dust viewed nearly edge-on from Earth. But look closer, and the sheer scale of this cosmic giant begins to emerge. It packs a massive total weight equal to 800 billion suns. Deep inside its core lies a dormant supermassive black hole weighing up to one billion suns. Advanced space telescopes revealed this giant is actually a scarred graveyard of galactic cannibalism. It grew by violently devouring and absorbing its smaller cosmic neighbors over eons. Astronomers now know this tranquil ring of stars is a mask.
